timing_verdict.label: GOOD
timing_verdict.text:
VERDICT: GOOD timing to buy USD with KRW now

RATE: 1300 KRW/USD

WHY: The won has strengthened significantly, with the exchange rate falling to the 1300 KRW range—a relatively cheap level for converting to dollars. News sources highlight that this is an attractive entry point for currency exchangers ("환테크족"), and analysts expect the rate may rise back toward 1360 KRW, suggesting the current 1300s represent a favorable window.

TIP: Since you must convert $2,000 monthly regardless, locking in this 1300-level conversion now is better than waiting for potential weakening; consider converting your full month's amount today rather than spreading it if rates drift toward 1360+.
